shots.intent: 搜索列表首图，用两枚腔体加一枚插头错落下垂的干净剪影赢一眼点击
一秒交代核心利益：小巧腔体贴合耳廓、线身直插即用
侧后上手代入日常通勤与通话佩戴，让买家想象自己戴上的样子
用侧面声学开孔与网织结构解释出声与佩戴结构，消除做工疑虑
俯看线控模块与侧孔，交代通话与音量操作位，参数与字样留空
用插接头微距证明直插端子的金属做工与防折尾部，读数与规格一律留空
交底到手件数与形态，用空白标签框消除到手落差与配件疑问

style.backgroundSystem: seamless warm paper white #FBF9F5 for packshot, mesh detail and contents screens, matte warm sand-beige #E4DACB field for wear and cable screens, deep graphite #2B2724 panel for the benefit and plug macro screens, one matte copper #B06B45 hairline as the only accent
style.direction: clean warm-neutral audio-accessory ecommerce, gallery paper plus graphite
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and empty rounded chip or seal outlines in matte copper #B06B45, no filled pictograms and no badges
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio lighting at 5500K, soft front-left softbox key with a bounce card on the shadow side, one low-incidence skimming sweep for mesh and metal texture, one restrained rim separation on dark fields, soft contact shadows only, no harsh specular bursts and no bloom
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean warm-neutral audio-accessory ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm paper white #FBF9F5, matte sand-beige #E4DACB, deep graphite #2B2724 and one matte copper accent #B06B45; neutral-warm bright even studio lighting at 5500K with a soft front-left key, a bounce fill, one low-incidence skimming sweep for texture, restrained rim separation on dark fields and soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif; thin single-weight line icons and empty rounded chip outlines only; smooth matte shells with fine surface grain and one controlled specular roll; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic scaffolding whose label areas stay blank; stable straight-on to slight 3/4 product scale and centring; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no rendered in-image copy, badges, digits or model names
style.presentationRules: stable straight-on to slight 3/4 scale for the shell bodies, stem, line-control module and plug head always readable and never overlapped by props, hands or cables; one unbroken cable line per frame
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm paper board #FBF9F5, brushed sand-beige studio surface #E4DACB, deep graphite slab #2B2724 under the plug macro
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif held inside the style system only; every glyph area is left blank for post-composited copy, no rendered lettering in frame
